decisionsTitle: «Coada de înscrieri» says when each waiting person sent the form, and lists them in that order when the club hands places out by hand
decisionsSection:
**The owner, 2026-10-01:** "Ei primesc mail dacă îi bag de pe lista de așteptare în lista finală?" — the club moves people off the waiting list by hand (`events.waitlist_auto_offer` «Nu», §615) and wants to follow the order in which the forms were sent, which the panel did not show: it listed the line by `waitlisted_at` and wrote only that moment.

**Decision.**

1. **The time, on every waiting row.** A `WAITLISTED` row of «Coada de înscrieri» (the event page's queue panel) says «Formular trimis: {when}» / «Form sent: {when}» from `submitted_at`, beside the moment the person joined the line (`waitlisted_at`), now labelled «pe listă din {when}» / «on the list since {when}» (it read «din {when}», unlabelled). Both go through `formatDay` in the event's own zone (§349, §369), like every other time on the panel — the club's zone for an event held in Romania. The registration's own backoffice page already carried both in its timeline («Pe lista de așteptare», and the form's time under «Trimisă»); the form's label is now «Formular trimis» / «Form sent» so the two screens say it alike. The panel's reader and the page are the Administrator's and the Organizer's, as before; the desk's rows are untouched.

2. **The order, by the setting.** `queueOrderFor(waitlistAutoOffer)` (`domain/waitlist.ts`, a pure function) picks the order the panel lists the line in: `SUBMITTED` — `submitted_at ASC, id ASC` — when the event's offers are off and the club picks by hand; `LINE` — `waitlisted_at ASC, id ASC`, `lockOldestWaitlisted`'s own order — when they are on, so the panel never shows an order the allocator will not honour. `listQueueForEvent` takes the order as a required argument. A lead line above the rows says which is shown: «În ordinea trimiterii formularului…» / «În ordinea intrării pe listă…». The open offers sit in the same list in the same order (they are part of the line, §92); only a `WAITLISTED` row carries the two times.

3. **Display only.** The allocator, the capacity formula, `lockOldestWaitlisted` and every automatic offer are untouched; `kind` is in no new condition; no migration.

4. **Never public.** The form's time is a backoffice line. The public list's select (`listPublicStartListOthers`) is not widened and `tests/privacy/public-surface.test.ts` stays as it was; the participant's own pages show nobody else's time.

**Refused.** Changing the allocator to offer by `submitted_at`: the line's position is the moment a place was refused, and the club's rule for offers on their own is §615's. Showing the form's time only on a hand-run event: the same fact helps either way, and the lead line already says which order is shown. Writing the clock in Romania's zone for an event held elsewhere: the panel reads the event's zone since §369, and a second clock on one row would be the confusion that section removed.
changelogLine: - **«Coada de înscrieri» says when each waiting person sent the form** — «Formular trimis: …» beside when they joined the line, and where the club hands places out by hand the line is listed in the order the forms were sent, with a lead line saying which order is shown; the allocator and the automatic offers are untouched, and nothing is added to the public list. §NNN.

specsCriteria.text: Given the queue panel of an event, when it lists the waiting, then each `WAITLISTED` row says when its form was sent (`submitted_at`) beside when the person joined the line, in the event's zone; the rows are in `submitted_at` order, then id, when the event's `waitlist_auto_offer` is false and in `waitlisted_at` order, then id, the allocator's own, when it is true; the lead line says which; and the allocator, `lockOldestWaitlisted` and every automatic offer still use `waitlisted_at` alone (2026-10-01, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Given the queue panel and the registration's own page, when they show a waiting registration, then each says when the form was sent, in both languages, to the staff roles that read the registrations only; no public list and no participant page carries that time of anybody else's (2026-10-01, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

batchLine: the queue panel says when each waiting form was sent and lists them in that order when places are handed out by hand
